purpose: Teach: 岩波書店/ワーキング/大学院生/読了/セーブ/日弁連/コンディション/クラッシュ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、岩波書店の文庫から教養を深めろ
lines.en: Ren — deepen your learning through Iwanami's pocket editions.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Light pressure on the imperative without harshness. The tone of someone who expects you to understand the weight of what he's suggesting. Brief pause before the command itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ワーキングペーパーを学会に投稿します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the working paper to the conference.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Quick intake of breath before responding. Forward momentum — showing he's already thinking through the steps. No hesitation, but not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、大学院生としての覚悟を持て
lines.en: Ren — you need to carry yourself with the resolve of a graduate student.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Weight on 「覚悟」. Slow, deliberate pacing. The voice of someone who sees potential and is calling it out directly. Eye-level steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行論文の読了を済ませます
lines.en: Yes. I'll finish reading the prior literature.
lines.style: Focused, nodding through the words. Quiet conviction. Each phrase lands — showing he's already committing to the work. No performance, just clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データのセーブをこまめに
lines.style: Practical, almost gentle in its brevity. No theatrics — just the voice of someone who has seen projects collapse. Direct eye contact. The efficiency of someone who doesn't waste words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究倫理は日弁連の助言も参考にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll also consult the Japan Federation of Bar Associations' guidance on research ethics.
lines.style: Respectful and thorough. Slight formality in the tone — showing deference to the reference. Steady rhythm, no breathiness. The voice of someone building a careful foundation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、自身のコンディションを整えろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure you take care of yourself.
lines.style: Quieter than before. A shift — less about protocol, more about seeing the person. Slight warmth underneath the direction. The concern beneath the mentor's authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置のクラッシュ防止策を講じます
lines.en: Yes. I'll implement safeguards against equipment crashes.
lines.style: Earnest, closing-statement finality. Slight breath-catch on the commitment. The voice of someone wrapping up with resolve. Not rushed, but aware this is the closing exchange.
